capabilities: Export selected keychain secret IDs to a passphrase-encrypted parcel file
Import a parcel with a preview and per-conflict overwrite choices
Read back written values and report written, skipped and failed IDs
Save export profiles and create dated encrypted backups with retention (Pro)
Compare a parcel against the current keychain without writing (Pro)
extras: Freemium: export, import and reports are free; profiles, backups and comparison require a $5/month or $15 GitHub Sponsors payment. Settings open a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins. The README warns the cryptography has no independent audit and lists untested platforms (Linux, physical mobile devices, cloud sync providers).
problem: Obsidian stores secret IDs per device keychain, so moving plugin credentials to a second device has no built-in path.

relations.evidence: Sign in uses the GitHub device flow.

summary: Exports selected keychain secrets to a passphrase-encrypted vault file and imports them on another device with a conflict preview and read-back report.
